verse.verse_1: Just look at him, who belies the religion!
verse.verse_2: So it is he, who pushes away the orphan,
verse.verse_3: And does not urge to feed the needy.
verse.verse_4: So ruin is to those offerers of prayer –
verse.verse_5: Those who are neglectful of their prayer.
verse.verse_6: Those who make a display (of their deeds).
verse.verse_7: And do not let others ask for small utilities.
